top_signals.title: US Stocks Climb as Tech Spurs Rally After Inflation Fears Ease
top_signals.summary: US stocks traded higher led by the technology sector, as investors turned their focus on a bumper earnings season after a subdued inflation reading helped ease interest-rate hike concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
